_comment: Demo seed for the on-chain registry. Badge ids are what the beacons blink (8-bit, two upper-case hex digits — the ID shown on the badge screen). `consent` is the initial on-chain state; flip it live on stage. Badges not listed here are auto-registered as opt_out by the service the first time a camera sees them.

badges.label: physical demo badge (the ID on its screen) — opted OUT (blurred)
